projection.name: cloudflare
projection.title: Cloudflare
projection.description: Cloudflare cockpit for accounts, zones, DNS, cache purge, tunnels, WAF/rulesets, page rules, certificates, Workers routes, settings, and API exploration.

fields.label: Default account ID
fields.help: Used by account-scoped APIs such as tunnels. Empty means all visible accounts are listed.

fields.label: Zone filter
fields.help: Optional substring filter for the zone list.

fields.label: Read-only mode
fields.help: Blocks write and destructive routes even when the token has permission.

config.instructions: Review Cloudflare zones, accounts, DNS, rulesets, tunnels, and safe cache actions from the sandboxed cockpit.
